title: WebSocket event contract registry
gapPolicy: Client must stop trusting incremental realtime state after a sequence gap and resync from an authoritative HTTP/PostgreSQL-backed snapshot before applying later events.
authorityBoundary: WebSocket events are delivery hints and projections only. PostgreSQL remains authoritative for auction state, accepted bids, winner selection and final results.

events.purpose: Full recoverable auction projection after connect or resync.
Projection that an authoritative bid transaction was accepted.
Delivery of a non-sensitive rejection result to the requesting client.
Projection of an authoritative anti-sniping/extension decision.
Explicit instruction to discard incremental assumptions and fetch authoritative state.
